name: 633. databricks-gemini-3-pro is billed at the list rate, not the promotional one upstream publishes (databricks pricing correction)
description: TXE-7688. The upstream datasheet bills databricks/databricks-gemini-3-pro input and output at 2e-06 and 1.2e-05, the promotional 0.8x of its DBU rates; every other Databricks Gemini row bills the list rate. The gateway corrects the two rates as it parses the datasheet (upstreamRateCorrections in framework/modelcatalog/datasheet/sync.go). The fixture's pricing sheet carries both rows exactly as upstream published them on 17 Nov 2026, and the rows read the rates back from the model catalog. databricks-gemini-3-6-flash is the control: its DBU cache keys disagree with its USD cache keys too, but there the USD keys are right, so the gateway must leave them.
